justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtypes wrap u64 IDs, AccountType is an enum, LedgerError is a typed enum with structured variants, and internal Account/Entry/Transaction types model the domain cleanly.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with three meaningful variants, no panics in library paths, and the single expect() has a clear comment justifying that the invariant was just validated.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Every public item has doc comments, derives are complete (Copy/Clone/Eq/Hash/Debug on IDs, Display on error), naming follows std conventions, and the public surface is narrow.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses iterator chains with map/collect, pattern matching, derives, matches! in tests, borrows entries before consuming, and avoids unnecessary clones; the i128 overflow guard is a thoughtful touch.
